meta.title: Payments — outegro
meta.description: Purchases, subscriptions and access across outegro.dev apps.

states.unavailableBody: The payments service didn't answer. Nothing is lost: your purchases and access are safe, we just can't show them right now.
states.invalidTitle: This link is out of date
states.invalidBody: The list has changed since this page was opened.
states.offline: You're offline. We'll carry on once the connection is back.

orders.title: Your
orders.lead: Everything you've bought with your outegro account, newest first. Access opens as soon as Lava confirms the payment.
orders.emptyBody: When you buy something in an outegro app, it shows up here with its status and a summary.
orders.unavailableBody: The payments service didn't answer, so we can't list your purchases right now. Nothing is lost: your purchases and access are safe.

order.notFoundBody: It may belong to another account, or the link is incomplete.
order.unavailableBody: The payments service didn't answer, so we can't show this order right now. Nothing is lost: the payment and your access are safe.

watch.processingBody: We're waiting for Lava to confirm it. This usually takes a few seconds; you can keep this page open.
watch.preparingBody: Lava is creating the payment page for this order.
watch.verifyingBody: The payment provider hasn't answered yet. We're checking the result with Lava; you don't need to pay again.
watch.activatingBody: Your payment is confirmed. We're switching on access in {service}.
watch.paidBodyGeneric: The payment is confirmed and access is open.
watch.failedBody: Lava didn't confirm this payment, so nothing was activated. Check your card or choose another payment method, then try again.
watch.refundedBody: The money was returned through Lava and the access this purchase opened was closed.
watch.unknownBody: Its status isn't one we recognise yet. It will show here as soon as it's confirmed.
watch.timedOutBody: Some payments take a few minutes. If you've paid, don't pay again: this order updates by itself.
watch.timedOutActivatingBody: Access is taking longer than usual to open. It switches on by itself; check again in a minute.
watch.offline: You're offline. We'll check again when you're back online.
watch.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see the result.
watch.gone: This order is no longer available.

summary.title: Order summary
summary.note: Lava emails the payment receipt. This summary is for your records and isn't a fiscal document.

subscriptions.title: Your
subscriptions.lead: Renewal, paid period and access for each subscription. Turning renewal off keeps everything you've already paid for.
subscriptions.emptyBody: Subscriptions you start in outegro apps show up here with their renewal date and access period.
subscriptions.unavailableBody: The payments service didn't answer, so we can't list your subscriptions right now. Nothing changed: renewals and access keep working.
subscriptions.grace: includes {days, plural, one {# grace day} other {# grace days}}

note.pending: Waiting for the first payment. Access opens once Lava confirms it.
note.past_due: The latest renewal hasn't been confirmed. Access stays until {accessUntil}.
note.cancel_requested: Stopping renewal: we're waiting for Lava to confirm. Access stays until {accessUntil}.
note.cancelling: Renewal is off. Access stays until {accessUntil}, then the subscription ends.
note.suspended: Access is paused while this subscription is being reviewed.

done.cancelling: Renewal is off. You keep access until {accessUntil}.
done.cancel_requested: We've asked Lava to stop renewal and are waiting for confirmation. You keep access until {accessUntil}.
done.unchanged: Nothing to change: this subscription already won't renew.

cancel.title: Cancel renewal?
cancel.body: {product} won't renew after {paidUntil}. You keep access until {accessUntil}: everything you've paid for stays yours.
cancel.notRefund: This isn't a refund, and nothing is charged for turning renewal off.
cancel.unavailable: We couldn't confirm the result. Trying again is safe: renewal won't be cancelled twice.
cancel.offline: You're offline. Nothing was sent; try again when you're back online.
cancel.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to manage this subscription.
cancel.gone: This subscription is no longer available. Refresh the page.

catalog.title: What you
catalog.lead: Products across outegro apps. You pay on Lava's secure page; access opens as soon as the payment is confirmed.
catalog.emptyBody: Products appear here once an outegro app starts selling them.
catalog.unavailableBody: The payments service didn't answer, so we can't show the catalog right now.
catalog.closedBody: You can look around; buying opens soon.

problem.owned: You already have this. See Purchases.
problem.gone: This product or currency is no longer offered. Refresh the page.
problem.blocked: The payment page address isn't one we trust, so we didn't open it. Nothing was charged.
problem.failed: Lava couldn't start this payment. Try again.
problem.slow: The payment page is taking a while. Your order is saved.
problem.unavailable: Couldn't reach the payments service. Nothing was charged; try again.
problem.offline: You're offline. Try again when you're back online.

errorBody.state_mismatch: The sign-in link expired or was opened in another browser.
errorBody.missing_code: The account service didn't confirm the sign-in.
errorBody.invalid_grant: The account service didn't confirm the sign-in.
errorBody.unavailable: The account service didn't answer in time.

auth.signedOutBody: You've signed out of Payments on this device. Your outegro account itself stays signed in, so signing back in takes one click.

errors.title: Something is temporarily unavailable
errors.body: Your purchases and access are safe. The page didn't load in time.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
